justification: The network satisfies every hypothesis. Its four cut capacities are 7, 7, 10, and 8. A feasible value-7 flow sends 3 on s→u, 4 on s→v, 1 on u→t, 2 on u→v, and 6 on v→t. Thus exactly two cuts are minimum. This witness uses equal sums of different crossing-arc sets; the reference instead uses isolated vertices that leave the crossing arcs unchanged.
